title: ICER Church Website
description: Institutional website for ICER Church — events, community content, and admin-managed media with a responsive public experience.
challenges: Split frontend/API deployment, MongoDB-backed auth when enabled, and file uploads stored on the server with URLs in the database.

title: JWT Auth API
description: REST authentication service with sign-up, login, refresh tokens, role-based access and rate limiting for client apps.
challenges: Secure token rotation, bcrypt password hashing, Redis-backed session revocation and consistent error contracts across endpoints.

title: Analytics Dashboard SaaS
description: Multi-tenant SaaS dashboard with KPI cards, date filters, exportable reports and subscription-aware feature flags.
challenges: Tenant data isolation, aggregated metrics without blocking the UI, and responsive charts on tablet and mobile.

title: ERP External Integration
description: Integration layer syncing orders, customers and inventory between internal services and external ERP APIs.
challenges: Idempotent webhook processing, retry policies with backoff, and normalizing inconsistent third-party payloads into a single domain model.

title: Boutique Brand Showcase
description: Premium landing experience with motion design, typography-led layout, scroll reveals and polished micro-interactions.
challenges: Smooth 60fps animations, accessible contrast ratios, and strong Lighthouse scores on mid-range mobile devices.

title: IXC Provedor Doc API
description: Documentation API for IXC Provedor — structured endpoints, versioned schemas and searchable reference for integrators and internal teams.
challenges: Keeping OpenAPI specs in sync with production routes, fast full-text search across modules, and clear auth examples for partner integrations.

title: SimpleBackup
description: Cross-platform backup app for non-technical users — guided setup, scheduled copies to local or cloud folders with plain-language status.
challenges: Simple UX without hiding reliability, conflict-safe restores on Windows/macOS/Linux, and low resource usage during background sync.
